name: Crunch
pose: Floor abdominal crunch with shoulder blades raised
accessibilityLabel: Grey mannequin curling the shoulders off the floor in a crunch, with abdominal muscles highlighted.
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: original square workout exercise illustration.
Input1 is the canonical identity/style REFERENCE ONLY; create the new exercise below.
Keep EXACT SAME adult pale slate-grey mannequin, oval bald head, natural athletic build, realistic proportions, matte material, short charcoal training shorts and charcoal shoes. Match restrained premium 3D rendering, soft upper-left lighting, light cool-grey #F3F5F7 background and subtle contact shadow.
Only specified exposed primary muscle bellies use muted coral #DF685A. Remove reference biceps highlights; do not highlight joints, bones, secondary muscles or through clothing. No glow or veins.
One whole figure and complete specified equipment, near-orthographic low-distortion camera, square 1024x1024, 7–9% margins. Plausible hands, limbs and support contacts. No text, logos, numbers, arrows, panels, duplicates or gym scenery.

Exercise: FLOOR ABDOMINAL CRUNCH at modest raised position. Lie supine with bent knees roughly90deg, feet flat hip-width. Pelvis/lower back remain grounded, only head and shoulder blades lifted a modest amount by curling ribs toward pelvis. Chin gently tucked, gap under chin, no pulling neck. Both arms crossed over chest, each hand touching opposite upper chest. SIDE-front three-quarter view clearly separates grounded lower back and hips from slightly raised shoulder blades; both feet and hands visible. Highlight exposed rectus abdominis and obliques ONLY. No equipment; no sit-up upright torso; whole figure square.

review.notes: Bent knees and flat feet, pelvis and lower back grounded, shoulder blades curled upward with crossed arms. Abdominal overlay avoids chest; whole figure visible.
review.independentNotes: Viewed full image: feet planted, knees bent and upper torso curled upward with lower back/pelvis near floor, arms crossed; distinct from full sit-up.
